method: Read official documentation through the web reader and independently recorded HTTP retrieval metadata. Semantic review and HTTP availability are distinct.

finding.zh: 文件、链接和可审阅交付；访问受限或不可读必须说明。
finding.en: Files, links and inspectable deliverables; inaccessible or unreadable material must be declared.

finding.zh: 共享电脑不是 Bot 之间的权限隔离；登录验证由用户接管。
finding.en: The shared computer does not isolate Bots; the user handles authentication steps.

finding.zh: 先验收单次任务，再保存方法并考虑重复运行。
finding.en: Accept a one-time task before saving a method and considering recurring runs.

finding.zh: Test 会执行实际工作；读取运行状态、失败原因和下一次运行时间。
finding.en: Test performs actual work; inspect state, failure reason and next run.

finding.zh: 安装不等于已授权；服务范围取决于所连接身份。
finding.en: Installation is not authentication; service scope depends on the connected identity.

finding.zh: 敏感操作的目标与范围先确认，密码与验证码不进入普通聊天。
finding.en: Confirm targets and scope for consequential actions; keep passwords and one-time codes out of ordinary chat.

finding.zh: 原邮件与草稿的标签规则不同，新回复不能由旧线程标签推断已处理。
finding.en: Original-message and draft label rules differ; existing thread labels do not establish handling of new replies.

finding.zh: 草稿容器身份与内部邮件身份分开；重复创建前核对已有草稿。
finding.en: Draft-container and contained-message identities differ; inspect existing drafts before retrying creation.

finding.zh: 查询必须保留范围限制，不能把会话结果数量当作原邮件数量。
finding.en: Retain query scope and do not equate conversation counts with original-message counts.

finding.zh: 时间窗使用明确偏移量，边界针对开始/结束时间不同，分页与同步条件另核对。
finding.en: Use explicit time offsets; start/end bounds differ, and pagination/synchronization parameters need separate checks.

finding.zh: 频道历史读取受身份、范围与分页限制，失败不能作为无消息。
finding.en: Channel history depends on identity, scope and pagination; failure is not an empty history.

finding.zh: 线程回复与频道历史分开取得，缺失内容要标明。
finding.en: Retrieve thread replies separately from channel history and declare missing coverage.

finding.zh: 起草结果与实际发送分开验收。
finding.en: Accept a prepared draft separately from actual delivery.

finding.zh: 区分成功、重定向与客户端/服务端错误，保留响应与未取得内容。
finding.en: Distinguish success, redirects and client/server errors while retaining responses and missing coverage.

finding.zh: 旧提交的检查不能替代当前有效版本；测试合并提交也可能是有效检查对象。
finding.en: Old-commit checks cannot replace the effective current version; a test-merge commit may be the applicable target.

finding.zh: 评审意见、修改和检查是不同证据，不能混成可合并状态。
finding.en: Review feedback, changes and checks are separate evidence and do not alone establish merge readiness.

finding.zh: 累计退款受原付款金额约束，提交、待处理、成功和失败不混同。
finding.en: Aggregate refunds are bounded by the original payment; submission, pending, success and failure differ.

finding.zh: 内部备注和公开回复均改变工单；创建评论经由 Tickets API。
finding.en: Both internal notes and public replies change tickets; comment creation uses the Tickets API.

finding.zh: 更新工单需检查并发冲突与实际结果，不重复覆盖他人变更。
finding.en: Inspect concurrent updates and actual outcomes rather than overwriting another update.

summarize-a-document.zh: 已核对文件输入、引用章节、交付文件和保留原件的要求；PDF/OCR 与真实文档实操分别验收。
summarize-a-document.en: Reviewed file inputs, section references, inspectable outputs and preservation of originals. PDF/OCR and actual document execution require separate checks.

gmail-inbox-triage.zh: 已核对连接授权、原邮件标签、草稿独立身份及新回复处理；连接器实际工具、保存和去重仍需账号实测。
gmail-inbox-triage.en: Reviewed authorization, labels on original messages, stable draft identity and new replies. Available connector tools, saved drafts and deduplication still need an account test.

website-daily-check.zh: 已核对 HTTP 状态码、只读巡检和 Routine 测试的区别；状态码不能代替业务验收，定时与后台仍未实测。
website-daily-check.en: Reviewed HTTP status classes, read-only inspection and actual Routine tests. Status codes do not establish business correctness; schedules and dashboards remain untested.

google-calendar-meeting-brief.zh: 已核对事件时间窗、时区、分页及重复/取消事件的查询条件；未验证账号中的工具或真实日程。
google-calendar-meeting-brief.en: Reviewed event time bounds, time zones, pagination and recurring/cancelled-event parameters. Account tools and real calendar data remain untested.

slack-daily-standup.zh: 已核对频道历史、线程回复、分页、可见范围及连接身份；未接入真实工作区，也未发送摘要。
slack-daily-standup.en: Reviewed channel history, thread replies, pagination, visibility and connected identity. No live workspace read or summary delivery was tested.

github-pr-watch.zh: 已核对最新提交/测试合并提交的有效检查、评审与合并状态；公开读取与 Notion 写入、持续跟进分开验收。
github-pr-watch.en: Reviewed effective checks for current head/test-merge commits, reviews and merge state. Public reads, Notion writes and sustained monitoring require separate acceptance.

stripe-refunds.zh: 已核对部分退款、累计金额上限及待处理/失败等状态；资料核验不代表账号权限、退款或客户通知已验证。
stripe-refunds.en: Reviewed partial refunds, aggregate amount limits and pending/failed states. Documentation review establishes neither account access nor live refunds or customer notifications.

zendesk-support-queue.zh: 已核对公开回复/内部备注、Tickets API 创建评论及更新冲突；未读取、提交或修改真实工单。
zendesk-support-queue.en: Reviewed public replies/internal notes, comment creation through the Tickets API and update collisions. No live tickets were read, submitted or modified.

shopping-compare.zh: 已核对页面读取、登录和付款接管边界；报价为合成材料，未核验商店实时价格、库存、税费或交易。
shopping-compare.en: Reviewed page access and user takeover for login/payment. Offers remain synthetic; live store prices, stock, taxes and transactions were not verified.

unresolved.zh: x.ai 与 Cursor 安全文档对个人 Auto-review 规则同步范围的描述不同，本轮未解决此差异；不作为 P0 的实测保证。
unresolved.en: The x.ai and Cursor security documentation describe personal Auto-review rule synchronization differently. This review did not resolve that discrepancy or certify it for P0.

limits.zh: 只核对列出的资料与规则。合成材料、HTTP 可访问、独立 Codex 脚本或 Bot 自报完成，均不等于 Grok Bot 真实流程验收通过。
limits.en: Review covers only listed sources and rules. Fixtures, HTTP access, independent Codex scripts and Bot self-reports do not establish a passed Grok Bot workflow.
